name: Kenzie Waistcoat

name: Yuma Double-Breasted Waistcoat
description: Mid grey, double breasted, shawl collar. A waistcoat with a front of its own, worn best where the jacket comes off.

name: Gabbro Marbled Waistcoat

name: Antwerp Wing-Tip Boot

name: Roma Wing-Tip Boot
description: Black calf and suede, laced, on a leather sole, made in Italy. The most forgiving boot here with a checked or textured suit.

name: Monaco Cap-Toe Boot

name: Chelsea II Boot
description: A black calf Chelsea with a brogued wing-tip, made in Italy. Pulls on, and goes under a suit trouser without a word.

name: Hamburg Wing-Tip Boot
description: Black calf, side zip, wing-tip toe, made in Italy on a leather sole. The boot for winter tailoring and a long evening.

name: Silvano Pocket Square
description: Navy silk with a fine ivory foliate print, made in Italy. The square for a navy or charcoal suit when the occasion is not about the square.

name: Paisley Pocket Square
description: Black silk with a small ivory paisley, made in Italy. It finishes black tie and charcoal tailoring without raising its voice.

name: Belagio Pocket Square
description: Deep teal paisley on near-black silk, made in Italy. Evening, and the one square here that reads as colour from across a room.

name: Venez Pocket Square
description: Copper baroque on black silk, made in Italy. It is the answer to the ochre blazer, and to brown tailoring generally.

name: Serenata Pocket Square
description: Blue and ivory silk stripe, made in Italy. The square for a patterned jacket, where another pattern would be one too many.

name: Black Leather Belt
